title: How to build an AI workflow without code, step by step
seoTitle: How to build an AI workflow without code
description: Build an AI workflow without code. Split a job into steps, set what each step takes in and gives back, add human checks and run it in your own AI.
lede: An AI workflow is one job split into small steps that your AI does one at a time, while you check the parts that matter. This guide shows how to plan one on paper, turn each step into a prompt and run it in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, with no code.
keywords: build an AI workflow without code
AI workflow automation for small business
